motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: link-underline

motion.name: stem-thicken
motion.purpose: Stem width 1.5px to 4px on hover or focus-within.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: 1600ms linear after 250ms (--draw, --draw-delay), scale 0 to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: The timeline track draws left to right at constant speed, once, on load.

motion.name: stop-arrive
motion.value: 420ms ease-out, opacity 0 and 6px down to rest, delay = draw-delay + t * draw
motion.purpose: Each timeline stop arrives when the line reaches its position t (0-1).

motion.name: years-arrive
motion.purpose: The year scale fades in when the draw ends.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Load motion runs only on desktop widths when the user has not asked for reduced motion; everything is visible without it.

motion.name: stop-fill
motion.purpose: Timeline stop dot fills green and its name turns green on hover or focus.

fonts.bangla: Anek Bangla 600 subset (src/fonts/anek-bangla-subset.woff2), unicode-range U+0020, U+0980-09FF, font-display block; subset includes U+0020 so it owns the line box. Rebuild with scripts/subset-bangla.py; scripts/check-bangla.mjs fails the build on uncovered characters.

extensions.build: A monthly scheduled rebuild (GitHub Actions cron, 1st of the month) keeps the timeline's track ending at today.

narrative.overview:
One horizontal line, the matra, crosses the page and everything hangs from it, the way Bangla letters hang from their headstroke. The line is not drawn beside the type; it is the type. Every green rule on the page is the headstroke of a Bangla word, measured from the font and run edge to edge, and every vertical green line is a stem dropped from that headstroke down the edge of the content it carries. The one horizontal green line that is not a headstroke is the career timeline's track, which closes the hero: a route line inside the page margins, measuring time at one scale. It is the world's line put to work, not a decorative stripe, and it is the hero's only green line.

The world is light only, flat, cool paper and near-black ink with one bottle green (Bangladesh flag green) that owns every structural line. Type and line carry every value: there are no cards, icons, photographs, shadows or gradients, and there is no depth at all. Density is moderate and editorial; results are set as figures on a strict tabular column, never as badges.

Motion is the line being drawn: on load the timeline track draws left to right at a constant speed, once, and each stop arrives as the line reaches it. Reading an entry thickens the stretch of stem beside it.
keyCharacteristics: One green, used only for structural lines, the Bangla words those lines belong to, and emphasis underlines.

Every full-bleed horizontal green line is a Bangla headstroke; every vertical green line in a section is a stem hanging from one; the timeline's track (turned vertical on phones) is the only other green line, and it lives in the hero.
A single axis: the left edge of the content column, with all read content indented 18px off its stem.
Two families: Anek Bangla (subset) for Bangla, Anek Latin for all Latin; tabular lining figures for every date and number.
Flat. No borders between items, no shadows, no gradients, no icons, no imagery.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to the line system and the Bangla words it comes from. It may underline the primary action and appear on hover and focus; it never fills a surface, a button, or a badge. The only green fill is a timeline stop, a dot on the line itself, under hover or focus.

rules.name: The No Grey Divider Rule
rules.body: Items are separated by space alone. Rule Grey exists only under resting links; there are no borders, hairlines or dividers anywhere.

rules.name: The Tabular Column Rule
rules.body: Every date and number uses tabular lining figures. Years read as a strict column.

rules.name: The Space-Owns-The-Line Rule
rules.body: The Bangla subset must contain U+0020. CSS takes line-box metrics from the first font that covers the space; if the subset lacks it, the Latin face sets the line box and every matra measurement drifts off the glyph bar. Re-run the subset script whenever Bangla text changes; the coverage check fails the build on a missing character.

rules.name: The Headstroke Rule
rules.body: Every full-bleed horizontal green line is a Bangla word's headstroke, cut to the measured matra band and run edge to edge of the viewport. The single exception is the timeline's track in the hero, which stays inside the page padding and carries time. Never draw any other green line that is not attached to a Bangla word.

rules.name: The Hanging Rule
rules.body: Every section hangs a `stem` (1.5px) green line from the bottom of its matra down the left edge of the content column to the foot of the section. All content in the section sits `hang` (18px) to the right of it. On phones the stem moves to the page edge and the rail is indented 18px too. Outside sections, the only vertical green line is the phone timeline's own stem (its track turned vertical), with its stops indented `hang` beside it.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing is lifted. No shadows, no blur, no gradients, no tonal surfaces; where a line meets a letter they fuse in the same green.

dos: **Do** cut every full-bleed green horizontal line to the matra band (`matra-top` 0.1815em to `matra-bottom` 0.278em, plus bleeds) of a Bangla word set at line-height 1, and run it edge to edge.
**Do** hang a 1.5px green stem from each section's matra down the content-column edge and indent all content 18px beside it.
**Do** keep U+0020 in the Bangla subset and re-run the subset and coverage scripts whenever Bangla text changes.
**Do** set every date and number in tabular lining figures.
**Do** show each place by organisation, years and the work done, with its measured result as a figure.
**Do** draw the timeline at one true time scale ending at the build month, and keep the monthly rebuild that moves its end to today.
**Do** keep the timeline's load motion tied to the line: a constant-speed draw, each stop arriving when the line reaches its position, and full content without motion.
donts: **Don't** use grey dividers, borders or hairlines between items; separate with space.
**Don't** use shadows, gradients, icons, photographs or other imagery.
**Don't** use green for fills, buttons, badges or decorative lines; the only green lines are headstrokes, stems and the timeline track, and the only green fill is a hovered or focused timeline stop.
**Don't** add a dark scheme or `prefers-color-scheme` styles; the site is light only.
**Don't** add a third type family or set Latin in the Bangla face.
**Don't** show job titles anywhere in content.
